newsitem.title: USA: Golden Eagle awarded to Liberty, not AIG.
newsitem.headline: Golden Eagle awarded to Liberty, not AIG.

text.p: Liberty Mutual Group said Monday the California Superior Court in San Francisco approved Golden Eagle Insurance Co's rehabilitation plan, which includes transferring the insurer's assets to private Liberty.

The court earlier overturned a decision by the California Insurance Department to award Golden Eagle to American International Group Inc. The department seized Golden Eagle in January following allegations of a reserve shortfall.

"The company now will receive the financial strength and 'A' rating of Liberty Mutual," said Fred Marziano, a Liberty senior vice president in charge of the Liberty Mutual Golden Eagle transition team, in a statement. "It will be run by local management and continue its partnership with more than 700 agents and brokers throughout the state."

American International Tuesday said it "will continue to work through independent brokers and agents" to sell insurance in California and was "pleased" the court order protects policy holders from a deadline that would have barred their claims. A spokesman declined to elaborate on the court ruling.
